draft.title: Selection
card: Selection is choosing the best applicant for a job from those who applied. It comes after recruitment, which is finding the applicants.
a conversation with the applicant. It shows communication and fit with the team, but the interviewer's bias can sway the result.
a test of personality, attitudes or thinking style. It gives a consistent measure across applicants, but it may not show how well someone does the job.

the applicant does a sample of the real job. It shows actual skills, but it takes time and may cost the business money to run. Online selection is a fourth method: applicants complete tasks or screening questions on a computer, which is fast for many applicants but shows little about the person.
draft.remember: Each selection method has strengths and limits, so a business picks the ones that suit the job.

a.q: Which selection method asks an applicant to do a sample of the real job?
a.why: A work test has the applicant do real tasks, so the business sees their skills first hand. An interview is only a conversation, so it does not show how well the person does the tasks.
a.clue: Which method lets the business watch the applicant do the job?

b.q: Priya's bakery in Ballarat gets 200 applications for one part-time role. She wants a quick, low-cost way to cut the list to a few people. Which method suits best?
opts: A full day work test for every applicant
A psychological test followed by a work test
b.why: Online screening is fast and can handle many applicants at once, so it suits a long list. A work test or interview for all 200 would take far too much time and cost, even though they show more about each person.
b.clue: Think about which method handles many applicants quickly.

problems.detail: Online selection, a separate method, is placed inside the work test bullet. Students may read it as part of the work test. It should be its own bullet.

check.summary: The facts and both questions are correct. Online selection is placed inside the work test bullet on the card and should be its own bullet so students do not confuse it with work tests.
